description: This file contains functions and type definitions for auditing and validating the configuration of a gateway service, including systemd and launchd integration, runtime checks, token validation, and path validation.

classes.name: GatewayServiceCommand
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a gateway service command configuration.

classes.name: ServiceConfigIssue
classes.description: Type representing an issue found during service configuration audit.

classes.name: ServiceConfigAudit
classes.description: Type representing the result of an audit, including success status and issues.

methods.name: hasGatewaySubcommand
methods.description: Checks if the program arguments include the 'gateway' subcommand.

methods.name: parseSystemdUnit
methods.description: Parses systemd unit file content to extract dependencies and restart settings.

methods.name: isRestartSecPreferred
methods.description: Checks if the RestartSec value matches the recommended 5 seconds.

methods.name: auditSystemdUnit
methods.description: Audits systemd unit file for required dependencies and restart settings.

methods.name: auditLaunchdPlist
methods.description: Audits launchd plist for required keys like RunAtLoad and KeepAlive.

methods.name: auditGatewayCommand
methods.description: Checks if the gateway command includes the 'gateway' subcommand.

methods.name: auditGatewayToken
methods.description: Validates embedded gateway token against expected token.

methods.name: readEmbeddedGatewayToken
methods.description: Reads the embedded gateway token from the command environment.

methods.name: getPathModule
methods.description: Returns the path module (posix or win32) based on platform.

methods.name: normalizePathEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a path entry according to platform conventions.

methods.name: auditGatewayServicePath
methods.description: Validates the PATH environment variable for minimal and non-minimal entries.

methods.name: auditGatewayRuntime
methods.description: Checks the runtime environment for Bun or Node, and Node version management issues.

methods.name: checkTokenDrift
methods.description: Detects drift between service embedded token and config token.

methods.name: auditGatewayServiceConfig
methods.description: Performs comprehensive audit of gateway service configuration based on environment, command, and platform.
